reason.observation: The original live gate repeatedly abstained because ordinary downside option skew could not independently reproduce a bullish view after market evidence was removed.
reason.change_goal: Restore a reachable but selective live options path without weakening the paper-account safety boundary.

changed.direction: Fresh SPY price momentum owns the sign; the live sleeve may compile either a bullish call spread or a bearish put spread.
changed.evidence_roles: Raw options skew and model-read Alpaca news may confirm, reduce, or neutralize the market view; neither may choose the sign.
changed.challenge_role: Source removals and 32 perturbations are published alpha diagnostics. An opposite-sign flip is prohibited, but diagnostic weakness cannot enlarge size or bypass execution safety.
changed.cadence: Three bounded cloud sessions run up to 24 five-minute cycles each during the options-entry window.

unchanged.allocation_sleeve: The four-fund competition allocation, its original orders, and its recorded P&L are unchanged.
unchanged.historical_evidence: Frozen research receipts and historical replays remain attributed to their original policy and are not relabeled as live-v2 results.
execution_safety: $500 maximum loss and a tighter 0.5% equity budget
Level 3, liquidity, flat-position, and exact-debit preflight
bounded credit-only exit with cancel confirmation and one final $0.01 replacement

claim_boundary: The calibration proves reachability and selectivity, not realized options profit or future outperformance. A live order or fill may be claimed only from a broker receipt. The bounded $0.01 exit floor limits behavior but cannot guarantee a fill.
